item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We believe this: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade of its arrival. Not shrink. Not retreat in a few countries. End everywhere.

2. We see an end to extreme poverty—not just another target for reducing it. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, that end will come everywhere within ten years of its arrival.

3. We reject the idea that extreme poverty must always exist. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within the following decade. That is the future we stand for.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade of its arrival. We mean every country and every community—not an improvement in global averages that leaves millions behind. We see superintelligence as the breakthrough that will put solutions to humanity’s deepest material problems within reach, from producing abundant food to delivering affordable healthcare. We refuse to treat extreme poverty as a permanent feature of human life. Our ambition is not to manage deprivation indefinitely, but to end it. We are committed to a future in which birthplace no longer condemns anyone to a life without the basics.
